title: A Theory of the Mechanics of Information: Generalization Through Measurement of Uncertainty (Learning is Measuring)
abstract: arXiv:2510.22809v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional machine learning relies on explicit models and domain assumptions, often limiting flexibility and interpretability. We introduce a "model-free" framework of instance-based learning using surprisal (information theoretic uncertainty) to directly analyze and perform inferences from raw data, eliminating distribution modeling, reducing bias, and enabling efficient updates including direct edits and deletion of training data. By quantifying relevance through uncertainty, the approach enables generalizable inference across tasks including generative inference, causal discovery, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting. Our approach emphasizes traceability, interpretability, and data-driven decision making, offering a unified, human-understandable framework for machine learning, can be adapted to virtually all machine learning tasks, achieving competency across all and state-of-the-art performance on anomaly detecti

translated_title: 信息力学理论：通过不确定性测量实现泛化（学习即测量）
translated_abstract: 传统机器学习依赖显式模型和领域假设，这常常限制了灵活性和可解释性。我们引入了一种“无模型”的基于实例的学习框架，利用惊奇度（surprisal，即信息论中的不确定性）直接对原始数据进行分析和推理，从而消除了分布建模的需求，减少了偏差，并支持高效的更新操作，包括直接编辑和删除训练数据。通过以不确定性来量化相关性，该方法能够在多种任务上实现可泛化的推理，包括生成式推理、因果发现、异常检测和时间序列预测。我们的方法强调可追溯性、可解释性和数据驱动的决策，为机器学习提供了一个统一的、人类可理解的框架，几乎可以适用于所有机器学习任务，在所有任务上均表现出色，并在异常检测上达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于信息论不确定性（惊奇度）的“无模型”学习框架，将学习视为对不确定性的测量，可直接从原始数据进行推理，支持数据的编辑与删除，并在异常检测等任务上达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a "model-free" learning framework based on information-theoretic uncertainty (surprisal) that treats learning as the measurement of uncertainty, enabling direct inference from raw data, efficient data editing and deletion, and state-of-the-art performance on anomaly detection.
